name: ArabSign
description: Sign language recognition has attracted the interest of researchers in recent years. While numerous approaches have been proposed for European and Asian sign languages recognition, very limited attempts have been made to develop similar systems for the Arabic sign language (ArSL). This can be attributed partly to the lack of a dataset at the sentence level. In this paper, we aim to make a significant contribution by proposing ArabSign, a continuous ArSL dataset. The proposed dataset consists of 9,335 samples performed by 6 signers. The total time of the recorded sentences is around 10 hours and the average sentence's length is 3.1 signs. ArabSign dataset was recorded using a Kinect V2 camera that provides three types of information (color, depth, and skeleton joint points) recorded simultaneously for each sentence. reputation: A useful Arabic sign language dataset/benchmark that fills an underrepresented area, but it is relatively specialized and not yet widely used outside the ArSL community.
notes: Moderate-sized dataset (9,335 samples, 6 signers) with multimodal Kinect inputs; likely limited by dataset size and signer/domain coverage.
